exclusions.reason_en: OAuth credential extraction plugin bridging Antigravity rate limits into OpenCode rather than using official agy CLI/ACP.

exclusions.reason_en: Multi-harness API proxy exposing Antigravity Claude/Gemini models to Claude Code and OpenClaw with reverse-engineered endpoints.

exclusions.reason_en: Region-lock and network sanction circumvention wrapper outside normal engineering tooling scope.
exclusions.reason_zh: 聚焦区域封锁与账号合规绕过的旁路工具，超出常规工程工具收录边界。

exclusions.reason_en: Region-lock and Google account geo-restriction bypass launcher.
exclusions.reason_zh: 聚焦区域限制与账号地区封锁绕过的旁路启动器。

exclusions.reason_en: Region eligibility and HTTP 403 restriction bypass patcher.
exclusions.reason_zh: 用于绕过地区准入与 HTTP 403 限制的旁路补丁。

exclusions.reason_en: Universal multi-IDE account manager covering Codex, Copilot, Windsurf, Kiro, Cursor, and others rather than 100% Antigravity-exclusive.
exclusions.reason_zh: 面向多款 AI IDE（Codex/Copilot/Windsurf/Cursor 等）的通用多平台账号工具，不符合 100% 专有原则。

exclusions.reason_en: Cross-agent wrapper invoking agy from Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and DeepSeek Harness.
exclusions.reason_zh: 同时面向 Claude Code、Codex 与 DeepSeek Harness 的跨平台包装工具。

exclusions.reason_en: Portable SKILL.md markdown prompt collection without dedicated executable Antigravity engineering tooling.
